name: Prepare original expedition using owned healing and natural Magicka recovery

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during expedition preparation')
 local h=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local m=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
 local s=types.NPC.stats.skills.restoration(self)
 print('VilverinContinue expedition health='..h..' magicka='..m..' restoration='..s.base..' progress='..s.progress)
 if h>=109.99 then print('VilverinContinue fully healed') end
 if m>=19 then print('VilverinContinue heal ready') end
end}}}}
